Local-first by design

Nothing leaves your machine

Every ShipCheck rule runs against your repository on your machine. Your code, secrets, and configuration are never uploaded, and no AI API is involved in scanning.

  • Local-first scanning. Rules execute against your local repo; results stay on your machine.
  • No external APIs. No code is sent to third parties during a scan.
  • Explainable results. Every finding names the rule, its weight, and a concrete fix.
  • Weighted Ship Score. A single score out of 100 across 16 categories.
  • Optional network checks. API probes and Lighthouse run only against a deploy URL you explicitly configure.

How it works

From local code to deployment-ready

Initialize your project, scan, inspect the Ship Score, and fix issues before deployment - all through the local CLI.

01

Initialize the project

Register the current directory as a ShipCheck project. Optionally pass --deploy-url to enable post-deployment checks.

npx shipcheck-cli07 init [--deploy-url URL]
02

Run shipcheck-cli07 scan

ShipCheck builds and tests in an isolated workspace, then runs every applicable check locally against your repository.

npx shipcheck-cli07 scan
03

Inspect the Ship Score

Review your weighted score out of 100, the category breakdown, and each explainable finding with its severity and fix.

04

Fix the blockers

Apply the concrete fixes, re-scan, and watch the score climb. Then deploy with confidence.

Install

Get started in seconds

Published as shipcheck-cli07. Run with npx or install globally.

Terminal
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 server
Dashboard: http://127.0.0.1:3140/?token=...
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 init
Project registered: my-app
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 scan
Scanning repository…
SHIP SCORE 92/100 · Ready to ship

Quick start (recommended)

npx
# Start the local dashboard
npx shipcheck-cli07 server

# In your project directory
npx shipcheck-cli07 init
npx shipcheck-cli07 scan

Global install

npm
npm i -g shipcheck-cli07

shipcheck-cli07 server

# In your project
shipcheck-cli07 init
shipcheck-cli07 scan

Optional: set SHIPCHECK_PASSWORD to secure your local dashboard. Add --deploy-url to init for post-deployment checks.
